errors.text_span: The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest (English) on the left and proceeding clockwise, with the “Other” category occupying the topmost position.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the segments are arranged in descending order of size proceeding clockwise from English. Following English (42.8%) clockwise is Spanish (31.4%), then Russian (5.7%), so the sequence is not descending from the start. Furthermore, the "Other" category (5.8%) is larger than the Russian category (5.7%), but it is placed at the top of the chart, breaking any simple descending order.
